schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT PLAYER_ID, DEVICE_ID FROM ACTIVITY WHERE (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE) IN ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID )
q2: WITH CTE AS ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FIRST_LOGIN FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT PLAYER_ID, DEVICE_ID FROM ACTIVITY WHERE (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE) IN (SELECT PLAYER_ID, FIRST_LOGIN FROM CTE)
